values.value: Finds: Multiple SBQQ__ConfigurationAttribute__c records on the same product feature with identical Name values. Why it matters: Pricing rules looking up the attribute by name find ambiguous matches — pricing fires inconsistently across quotes. Sales sees the same product priced differently on different days. Suppress a finding: when the duplicates intentionally serve different display contexts (e.g. variations across pricebooks) and downstream lookups use a more specific key. Disable the detector: only if your org has formal naming-collision handling at the rule layer. Most should leave this on.
